title: 3dNetCorr
description: Compute correlation matrix of a set of ROIs based on mean time series

in_rois.description: Input a set of ROIs each labelled with distinct integers. Multiple subbricks can be input, each will be treated as a separate network.
in_rois.title: Input ROIs file

mask.description: Whole brain mask within which to calculate correlation.
mask.title: Mask

fish_z.description: Output Fisher Z-transform matrix along with correlation matrix.
fish_z.title: Fisher Z-transform flag

ts_out.description: Output the mean time series of the ROIs.
ts_out.title: Time series output flag

ts_label.description: Insert the integer ROI label at the start of each line of the *.netts file created.
ts_label.title: Time series label flag

ts_indiv.description: Create a directory for each network that contains the average time series for each ROI in individual files.
ts_indiv.title: Individual time series flag

ts_wb_corr.description: Perform whole brain correlation for each ROI's average time series and output as Pearson 'r' values.
ts_wb_corr.title: Whole brain correlation flag

ts_wb_Z.description: Perform whole brain correlation for each ROI's average time series and output as Fisher transformed Z-scores.
ts_wb_Z.title: Whole brain Fisher Z-score flag

weight_ts.description: Input a 1D file of weights to be applied multiplicatively to each ROI's average time series.
weight_ts.title: Weight time series

weight_corr.description: Input a 1D file of weights to estimate a weighted Pearson Correlation.
weight_corr.title: Weight correlation

ts_wb_strlabel.description: Apply string labels to the WB correlation/Z-score output files.
ts_wb_strlabel.title: Whole brain string label flag

nifti.description: Output any correlation map files as NIFTI files.
nifti.title: NIFTI output flag

output_mask_nonnull.description: Output mask of non-null time series.
output_mask_nonnull.title: Output non-null mask flag

push_thru_many_zeros.description: Push through the calculation even if any ROI contains more than 10 percent of voxels with null time series.
push_thru_many_zeros.title: Push through many zeros flag

allow_roi_zeros.description: Allow ROIs to have all-zero time series.
allow_roi_zeros.title: Allow zero-filled ROI flag

automask_off.description: Disable internal automasking of where time series are not uniformly zero.
automask_off.title: Automask off flag

ignore_LT.description: Ignore any label table labels in the '-in_rois' file.
ignore_LT.title: Ignore label table flag
